evidence.title: Roche press release, Basel, 7 February 2026: fenebrutinib in primary progressive MS (mentions FENhance 2 in RMS)
evidence.text: Verbatim extracts from the source: the first of two Phase III relapsing multiple sclerosis (RMS) studies (FENhance 2) met their primary endpoints [...] Regulatory submission for fenebrutinib in both PPMS and RMS is planned following the Phase III FENhance 1 readout

evidence.title: Clinical Trials Arena, 3 March 2026: Roche's fenebrutinib trial meets primary endpoint (FENhance 1)
evidence.text: Verbatim extracts from the source: a reduction of 51% in annualised relapse rate (ARR) when compared to teriflunomide [...] Fatal cases were reported: one in the teriflunomide arm and eight in the fenebrutinib arm

meta.note: fatal cases appear in the FENhance 1 section; the article does not tie them to a specific study

evidence.title: Genentech press release (Business Wire, Nov 2025): fenebrutinib shows positive Phase III results (FENhance 2, FENtrepid)
evidence.text: Verbatim extracts from the source: significantly reduced the annualized relapse rate (ARR) compared to teriflunomide [...] Liver safety was consistent with previous fenebrutinib studies.

claims.claim: The first of two Phase III relapsing-MS studies of fenebrutinib (FENhance 2) met its primary endpoint.
claims.quote: the first of two Phase III relapsing multiple sclerosis (RMS) studies (FENhance 2) met their primary endpoints

claims.claim: In the Phase III FENhance 1 trial fenebrutinib reduced the annualised relapse rate by 51% versus teriflunomide.
claims.quote: a reduction of 51% in annualised relapse rate (ARR) when compared to teriflunomide

claims.claim: Fenebrutinib significantly reduced the annualized relapse rate versus teriflunomide in Phase III (FENhance 2).
claims.quote: significantly reduced the annualized relapse rate (ARR) compared to teriflunomide

claims.claim: Roche plans regulatory submission of fenebrutinib in PPMS and RMS after the FENhance 1 readout.
claims.quote: Regulatory submission for fenebrutinib in both PPMS and RMS is planned following the Phase III FENhance 1 readout

claims.claim: Liver safety in the Phase III fenebrutinib programme was reported as consistent with previous fenebrutinib studies.
claims.quote: Liver safety was consistent with previous fenebrutinib studies.

claims.claim: Fatal cases were reported in the Phase III RMS programme: one in the teriflunomide arm and eight in the fenebrutinib arm; investigations are ongoing.
claims.quote: Fatal cases were reported: one in the teriflunomide arm and eight in the fenebrutinib arm
